description: This source file implements a platform-dependent utility function for creating a module container object in the ANSC framework. It primarily defines the function AnscCreateModuleContainer which calls an internal creation function.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscCreateModuleContainer(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Creates and returns a new module container object handle, passing through the provided context and reserved handles to the internal creation function.
